data_description.notify_live: Filtration must be selected in Equipment to monitor. Replaces its start notification, sent after 1 minute of running, with a live card on the lock screen: progress bar of the scheduled window, or a timer if the window is unknown. Removed at stop. Other equipment keeps its normal notifications. Needs iOS 17.2 or later or Android 16 or later, and Home Assistant 2026.7 or later. An unsupported phone shows a normal notification instead. iOS ends a Live Activity after 8 hours.
